request.prompt:

At least one real flat sole/toe support at every phase; NO flight/hovering. Both leg chains are visible and attached, opposite foot alternation and arm counter-swing must be real. Pelvis/head rise and fall slightly through knees, not scaling. Keep broad transparent gutters between all64 figures. No repeated neutral feet, no both feet hanging, no floating crystals.
